cause: AC-II13 fell because the Windows checkout core.autocrlf=true rewrote the inspected notebook LF bytes as CRLF, while the Unit I verifier compared the raw observed hash to a canonical LF hash. Re-executing the notebook was not the cause; canonical notebook contents remained equal after newline normalization.

failing_assertions: test_positive_fixture: verifier returned nonzero because notebook_matches_prior_observed_hash was FAIL

fix.change: Record both local-byte and normalized notebook hashes; compare only canonical content hash and state that continuity does not authenticate saved outputs historically.

limitations: La evidencia completa del verificador U2 permanece sólo en el clon temporal porque su JSON contiene la ruta raíz temporal; no se copió como evidencia oficial del proyecto. SQL Server y aprobación docente no se simularon.
